bio: Afternoon Tea Awards 2023 - 'Award of Excellence'  Originally opened as the Grand Central Hotel in 1899, The Landmark London was the last of the great Victorian railway hotels and is now a Grade II listed building.  Today, you can experience The Landmark's quintessentially London Afternoon Tea in inimitable style under the high palms of their magnificent Victorian Winter Garden atrium. The setting is serene and magical, the atmosphere relaxed and refined with the soft sound of piano and daylight twinkling through.  Indulge in an irresistible assortment of delicate finger sandwiches, freshly baked scones with delicious preserves and clotted cream, along with a selection of crafted cakes and pastries designed by the Pastry Chefs Mauro and Daniel, winners of Bake Off: The Professionals 2023.
